operating_notes.text: Company is establishing an additional layer bird capacity of 20 lakh birds, taking total capacity to 24 lakh layer birds.
The company is undertaking a ₹400 Cr capex to expand EC layer bird capacity from 20 lakh to 40 lakh birds by 2029.
Board approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of SKM Universal Marketing Company (India) Private Limited into SKM Egg Products Export (India) Limited.
Average realization in Q2 was approximately ₹700.
Company is considering importing soya to reduce raw material costs by ~10%.
Powder sales volume for Q2FY27 was 1,625 metric tons.

timeline.summary: SKM Shree Shivkumar confirmed no encumbrance by promoters, group, or concerted persons on SKM Egg Products Export India Limited’s shares for FY2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹186.65 Cr (+58.9% YoY), net profit ₹32.78 Cr (+413.8% YoY).
SKM Egg Products provided detailed insights on its ~400 Cr poultry farm expansion project, funded via ~300 Cr bank borrowings and ~100 Cr internal accruals.
SKM Egg Products reported in Q2FY27 consolidated net profit at ₹17.75 Cr and approved the merger of its trading subsidiary.
SKM Egg Products Export (India) Limited recorded investor meeting held on Oct 23, 2026.
SKM Egg Products reported Q2FY27 PAT of ₹16 Cr and secured ₹300 Cr in term loans for its poultry farm expansion.
